instructions: Slice the tomatoes 1/4 inch thick and lay the slices on a double layer of paper towels.
Sprinkle the slices with 1/2 tsp salt and leave them for 5 to 7 minutes to drain.
Spread 1/2 tbsp of mayonnaise on each of the 8 bread slices.
Layer the tomato slices over 4 of the slices. Dab the tops with a paper towel first if they look wet.
Grind black pepper over the tomatoes, using about 1/2 tsp in all, then close the sandwiches with the other slices.
Cut the sandwiches in half and serve right away.
method_notes: A Cozy Kitchen (5.0 from 3) is the only recipe rated and read; Spend With Pennies and Belly Full were not readable, so this is a fallback lead. The method is a mayo spread on bread, salted tomato slices drained on paper towels, and pepper. Amounts are scaled from two sandwiches to four, with mayonnaise spread on the bread's inside faces.
